broad_label_leakage.method: explicit out-of-fold metadata residualization; 5-fold GroupKFold by physical leaf; categorical section/Currier/hand fit only on training folds; PCA fit to cross-fitted residuals
broad_label_leakage.interpretation: The leading two residual axes retain little broad-label association under explicit cross-fitted nuisance removal.

resampling_stability.method: physical-leaf bootstrap of the Phase57 W20 residual matrix, 300 resamples; compare top-2 PCA subspace with full-data top-2
resampling_stability.interpretation: The leading residual 2D subspace is stable to hierarchical resampling at the physical-leaf level.

audit_note: An intermediate reimplementation of the richer page-context residualizer produced larger apparent metadata eta2 (~0.13-0.18). Because this conflicted with Phase56D and mixed context construction/model choices, it was not accepted as the broad-label gate. The explicit categorical cross-fitted residualization above is the controlled H57-4 test. The discrepancy is retained as evidence that higher-order residual details are model-sensitive.

phase57_decision.H57_2: SUPPORTED FOR LEADING 2D RESIDUAL; HIGHER AXES SCALE-SENSITIVE
phase57_decision.H57_3: SUPPORTED RELATIVE TO TESTED LEAKAGE-SAFE LOCAL CONTEXT MODELS
phase57_decision.H57_4: SUPPORTED FOR LEADING 2D RESIDUAL UNDER EXPLICIT CROSS-FITTED METADATA REMOVAL

accepted_target: Only the leading consensus residual subspace (approximately 2 dimensions) is promoted beyond the robustness gate. Do not treat PCs 3+ or representation-specific axes as stable information-bearing candidates.
next: Define Phase58 content/cipher tests prospectively against the frozen 2D consensus residual. Independent content evidence and same-state matched controls are required; no free semantic relabeling after seeing results.
